local_context.value: Laurel Bay is a census-designated place and military housing complex in Beaufort County that primarily houses military families stationed at MCAS Beaufort, MCRD Parris Island and Naval Hospital Beaufort; the housing area opened in the mid-1950s (1,955 housing units in 2000); 5,082 residents at the 2020 census. Its 65+ share was 1.2% in the 2000 census (old figure); Beaufort County overall: 28.4% were 65+ in 2020. MCAS Beaufort is about 5 km from the housing complex.
